name: Native Office Round Trip
description: Workflow for DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX creation, import, redline, comment, visual render QA, and export verification.

chain.step: Resolve requested format, source artifact, target output, and whether native export or HTML normalization is acceptable.
Use document-workflow for supported HTML, PDF, PPTX, XLSX, and Markdown generation paths.
For DOCX requests, state the current runtime boundary and use an external/native conversion path only when explicitly available.
Generate charts or diagrams as durable assets before embedding in documents.
Render or preview in the target medium and verify readability, page breaks, captions, tables, images, and contrast.
